long_biography.plain_text:
Aviator lets players join a brief multiplayer round whose wager must be cashed out before the rising multiplier disappears. David Natroshvili founded the developer in 2018 and built a business supplying this kind of interactive game to licensed online gambling operators. Rather than run a consumer casino, his team develops the software that those platforms distribute. The company secured a British gambling software licence and broadened distribution through content partners.

As the business grew beyond its original small team, Natroshvili had to relinquish some product, hiring and customer decisions. He has described shifting his attention toward direction and people while retaining the founder's chief executive role. His career also encompasses earlier business and public-sector experience, and he later supported a small-business development centre at his Pennsylvania alma mater. The core private enterprise remains the game developer he established, now with operations and partners across several regulated markets.
